results.content: n the decade since publication of the first edition of this Handbook, the number of researchers in the social and behavioral sciences with at least a basic understanding of structural equation modeling (SEM) and its use has increased dramatically. SUMMARY AND CONCLUSION This chapter has examined the analyses of structural equation models with small sample sizes and many variables. Additional research is needed on new developments that focus on test statistics following ridge estimation methods, along with computational formulas that can yield accurate SEs. In this chapter, we also primarily reviewed a variety of SEM methods based on modeling the sample covariance matrix S. Evaluating small sample approaches for model test statistics in structural equation modeling.
